{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# First, check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
num_duplicates = duplicate_patients.sum()

# Show the duplicate patient_ids
duplicate_ids = df[duplicate_patients]['patient_id'].unique()

# Now, keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

print(f"Number of duplicate patient_ids: {num_duplicates}")
print(f"Unique patient_ids after dedup: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Original rows: {len(df)}")

# Check that no patient_id appears more than once now
df_dedup_check = df_dedup['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Deduplicated df has {df_dedup_check} duplicate patient_ids")"}
